title: Pet-Friendly Communities: Designed for Every Member of Your Family
summary: Learn about pet-friendly communities and how Toll Brothers designs communities with pet-focused amenities like dog parks, trails, and more.
body_markdown:
Last updated on September 22nd, 2026


When choosing a new home, it is important to consider the comfort of every member of the family, including beloved pets. Many of today’s luxury home buyers are looking for pet-friendly communities that actively integrate thoughtful amenities designed to enrich the daily living experiences of both the people and pets who live there.


Explore an array of pet-friendly amenities in Toll Brothers communities across the country and discover the benefits of living in an environment in which pets and owners alike can thrive.


## Quick Summary


- Toll Brothers communities often feature an array of pet-friendly amenities such as dog parks, walking trails, and pet-washing stations.
- These features create an elevated living experience for pets and owners alike.


[Toll Brothers in Ambler, PA](https://www.tollbrothers.com/luxury-homes/Pennsylvania)


## What Does It Mean to Be a Pet-Friendly Community?


A pet-friendly community is intentionally designed to support pets and their owners by integrating thoughtful amenities and features. These communities enrich daily living by addressing practical needs and lifestyle preferences, fostering social connections, and creating a harmonious environment for all residents.


## Luxurious Amenities for Pets and Their Owners


Toll Brothers is dedicated to luxury living for every family member, including pets. Many of our communities offer pet-friendly amenities such as:


- Dog parks: Safe, welcoming spaces for pets to socialize and exercise
- Pet-washing stations: Thoughtfully designed facilities for grooming
- Walking trails: Scenic paths perfect for daily walks
- Open space: Ideal for outdoor enjoyment


These amenities help residents and their pets live comfortably, conveniently, and luxuriously every day.


### Dog Parks Designed for Connection and Play


Within many Toll Brothers communities, dedicated dog parks offer secure, well-maintained spaces where pets can run freely and socialize. These areas are intentionally designed to encourage interaction, not only for pets but for neighbors as well, fostering a sense of community through shared experiences. Open spaces create a comfortable setting where residents can relax while pets enjoy time off-leash.


[Seabrook Village by Toll Brothers in Ponte Vedra, FL](https://www.tollbrothers.com/luxury-homes-for-sale/Florida/Seabrook-Village)


### Pet-Washing and Grooming Stations


After a walk along the trails or an afternoon at the park, dedicated community pet-washing stations make it simple to keep your pet and home clean. These thoughtfully designed spaces provide a practical solution for grooming, allowing residents to conveniently bathe, dry, and brush their pet. It is a small detail that adds ease to the daily routine.


[The Rockwell by Toll Brothers in New York, NY](https://www.tollbrothers.com/luxury-homes-for-sale/New-York/The-Rockwell)


### Walking Trails That Elevate Daily Rituals


Scenic walking trails wind throughout many Toll Brothers communities, offering a peaceful backdrop for morning walks and evening strolls. These pathways encourage an active lifestyle while allowing residents and their pets to enjoy the beauty of their surroundings. Whether it is a quick outing or a leisurely walk, these trails transform everyday moments into opportunities to unwind and reconnect.


[Cascadia at Grane Dunes by Toll Brothers in Myrtle Beach, SC](https://www.tollbrothers.com/luxury-homes-for-sale/South-Carolina/Cascadia-at-Grande-Dunes)


## Choosing Your Ideal Pet-Friendly Home


When selecting a home within a pet-friendly community, consider the following important aspects:


- Availability of nearby pet amenities, such as parks
- Proximity and access to outdoor spaces for exercise and leisure
- Any Homeowners Association (HOA) policies regarding pets


[Toll Brothers at Adero Canyon in Fountain Hills, AZ](https://www.tollbrothers.com/luxury-homes-for-sale/Arizona/Toll-Brothers-at-Adero-Canyon)


## Embrace a Pet-Friendly Lifestyle


Homeowners in pet-friendly communities enjoy an elevated way of living, with convenient access, beautiful surroundings, and amenities tailored to their cherished pets’ needs.


For more ideas on pet-friendly living, explore our blog post on[creating an ideal space for your pet](https://tollbrothersinc-my.sharepoint.com/personal/nprague_tollbrothers_com/Documents/Desktop/To%20create%20an%20ideal%20pet%20space%20at%20home,%20explore%20more%20in%20our%20blog%20post%20on%20creating%20a%20space%20for%20your%20pet.) at home on the Toll Brothers Build Beautiful blog.
